title: swida scabrida
intro: Swida scabrida, commonly known as Viburnum scabridum, is a plant species in the family Adoxaceae. It is a deciduous shrub native to China, used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been reported to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids are responsible for the medicinal properties of Swida scabrida, although further research is needed to fully understand its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions.
